source_change.new_capability: GGML_MOE_STREAM_CACHE_ADMIT_NAME_FILTER limits one-stream VRAM cache insertion by tensor name while still allowing matching tensors to stream through GPU uncached

conclusion: Preventing up from entering the gate cache did not recover performance. It worsened eval_tok_s to 1.7 because up still pays repeated uncached expert H2D/MMVQ/D2H, and down fallback remains. This rejects simple name-based admission as a route to generalized improvement.
next_action: Stop simple up one-stream/admission sweeps. Next work should quantify/implement a combined up/down movement reduction, persistent prompt-general residency, or a different kernel path with hard transfer bounds before running more cold benchmarks.
